# Southern Suds Powerwashing LLC

> Small, family-owned pressure washing and soft washing company owned by Dustin, serving Palm Coast, St. Augustine and Flagler and St. Johns Counties, Florida. Licensed and insured. Rated 5.0 on Google and named a Top 5 business in Palm Coast (2025). Slogan: "Your time to shine."

## Business facts
- Name: Southern Suds Powerwashing LLC
- Owner: Dustin
- Service area: Palm Coast, St. Augustine, Flagler Beach, Bunnell, Flagler County and St. Johns County, Florida
- Phone (call or text): (386) 276-1451
- Licensed and insured
- Brings its own water to jobs
- Estimates: free, competitive, no job too small
- Google rating: 5.0

## Services
- House and siding washing (vinyl, aluminum, stucco, brick)
- Roof washing
- Lanai and screen enclosure cleaning
- Driveway, sidewalk, walkway and garage cleaning
- Paver, patio, fire pit and pool deck cleaning
- Deck, dock, outdoor shower and fence washing
- Gutter cleaning and window, sill and soffit washing
- Commercial pressure washing: gas stations, storefronts, parking areas

## What customers mention most
Honest, meticulous, detail oriented, takes his time, prices lower than other quotes, careful with plants and older siding.
